name: _media-converter.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  cms/_media-converter.scss — the localhost-only media converter tab:
//  dropzone, conversion file list with grouped rows, progress bar,
//  spinner + cms-spin keyframes, and error text.
//  Imported by cms.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Media Converter (localhost-only) ──────────────────────────────────
.cms-tab-badge {
  margin-left: var(--space-xs);
  padding: 0 var(--space-xs);
  border-radius: var(--space-2xs);
  background: $cms-accent;
  color: $cms-bg-card;
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

.cms-dropzone {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  padding: var(--space-2xl) var(--space-lg);
  border: to-rem(2px) dashed $cms-border;
  border-radius: var(--space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  text-align: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    border-color 0.2s ease,
    background 0.2s ease;

  &--over {
    border-color: $cms-accent;
    background: $cms-bg-darker;
  }

  p {
    margin: 0;
    color: $cms-text-primary;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }
}

.cms-dropzone-icon {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  line-height: 1;
}

.cms-media-list {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--space-2xs);
  max-height: to-rem(340px);
  overflow-y: auto;
  margin: var(--space-md) 0;
  padding: var(--space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  border: to-rem(1px) solid $cms-border;
  border-radius: var(--space-xs);
}

.cms-media-list--errors {
  border-color: $cms-danger;
}

.cms-media-list-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
}

.cms-media-list-group {
  padding: var(--space-2xs) 0;
  border-bottom: to-rem(1px) solid $cms-border;

  &:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
  }
}

.cms-media-list-name {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: $cms-text-primary;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-media-list-size {
  color: $cms-text-subtle;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.cms-media-list-out {
  font-family: monospace;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  color: $cms-accent;
  padding-left: var(--space-md);
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-media-list-error {
  color: $cms-danger;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  text-align: right;
  word-break: break-all;
}

.cms-list-head {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: var(--space-md);
  margin-top: var(--space-md);
}

.cms-progress {
  height: var(--space-sm);
  background: $cms-bg-card;
  border-radius: var(--space-2xs);
  overflow: hidden;
  margin: var(--space-md) 0;
}

.cms-progress-fill {
  height: 100%;
  background: $cms-accent;
  border-radius: inherit;
  transition: width 0.3s ease;
}

.cms-loader-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  margin-top: var(--space-sm);
}

.cms-spinner {
  width: var(--space-md);
  height: var(--space-md);
  border: to-rem(2px) solid $cms-border;
  border-top-color: $cms-accent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: cms-spin 0.9s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes cms-spin {
  to {
    transform: rotate(360deg);
  }
}

.cms-btn-row {
  display: flex;
  gap: var(--space-sm);
  align-items: center;
}

.cms-error-text {
  color: $cms-danger;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}
